description: Published SP+ factors with projection agreement; grades measure matchup support, not calibrated win probabilities.

total.A: One team's offense, defensive points allowed and tempo all support the projected direction at strong_z, with mean matchup tempo in agreement.
total.B: Both offense-versus-opposing-defense pairings favor the projected direction and mean matchup tempo agrees; or one strongly favorable pairing with extreme supporting tempo.

spread.A: The projected cover side has strong relative offense and defense advantages, with no extreme role-tempo conflict.
spread.B: The projected cover side has at least one relative offense/defense advantage and no extreme role-tempo conflict.
